Looking at this question, I need to find the best example that illustrates the concept of "okugumirawo" (sustainability) in the context of technology and products.

Let me analyze each option:

A. Cooking noodles for 4 people, but only 3 eat, then cooking more noodles for the person who was absent - This shows waste of energy and water, not sustainability.

B. A farmer rotating different crops with different nutritional needs across years to maintain soil nutrients for future planting - This demonstrates sustainable agricultural practices that preserve resources for the future.

C. A student with a phone that has a small battery that drains quickly while gaming, so switches to a faster charger - This is about convenience, not sustainability.

D. A furniture maker who uses wood efficiently by using the full board and giving scraps other uses, reducing waste and promoting this as adding value - This demonstrates sustainable use of resources and waste reduction.

Both B and D show sustainability principles. However, D is more directly related to technology/products (furniture making with efficient resource use and waste reduction), which aligns better with the lesson topic "Bintu eby'Tekinologiya Ebikola Obulungi Ate Ebigumirawo" (Technology Products that Work Well and are Sustainable).

D

Looking at this question, the teacher is starting a project to build an automatic pet feeder because one student left their dog home alone all day. The question asks what the teacher can do to help students in this part of the project.

Let me analyze each option:

A. Research the design plan for a useful technological project that was set up by a group of students.

B. Explain the process/steps needed to make something, so students can understand how to build their technological creation.

C. Provide support on the development of the building project based on following the path in the book.

D. This appears to be commitment forms (individual and group contracts) for the project work.

Since they are just starting the project (atandika = begins/starts), the most appropriate pedagogical action would be to explain the process and steps needed so students understand how to approach building their technological creation.

B
